project-gap-analysis.summary: Deep analysis of PDF Framework (43 phases, 120+ files) vs SOTA RAG 2025-2026. Key gaps: embedding model (E5→BGE-M3/Jina-v3), observability (1 file vs Langfuse), graph store (NetworkX→Neo4j), CI/CD. Strengths: Section-First search, Ralph Wiggum, Triad architecture, Hybrid Loader.

mcp-lazy-loading.summary: MCP tool token bloat solutions: allowedTools filtering (0 effort), Claude Code Tool Search (85% reduction, auto), mcp-cli (99% reduction, cross-agent). Threshold: 20+ tools. Current project: 12 tools (OK). Combined with 1C-Enterprise: ~30 tools (needs strategy). Source: docs/MCP_CLI_Исследование.md

p1-search-quality-implementation.summary: Implementation analysis of P1 Search Quality (Phases 47-50). Overall ~30%. Q3 Streaming 80% (SSE works, WebSocket missing). Q1 Embedding 40% (E5+Giga exist, Jina missing). Q2 Late Chunking 0% (blocked by Q1). Q4 Contextual Retrieval 0% (independent). Recommended order: Q3→Q4→Q1→Q2. Total 6-9 days.

posttooluse-skill-activation-bug.summary: PostToolUse:Skill never fires (bug #6305). Research of 25+ sources, 10+ repos. 5 established patterns: UserPromptSubmit parse (100% reliable, 1-turn delay), File-system IPC, Forced-eval (80-84%), Stop transcript verification, PreToolUse block (~95%). Current combo A+E works with 1-turn delay. Recommended A+E+D combo for ~99% coverage.
